lessons.intro:

lessons.title: Saving, closing, and testing figures
lessons.intro:
Matplotlib 3.8+. Assumes Python functions, collections, and imports. Standard aliases: np=numpy, plt=matplotlib.pyplot, torch=PyTorch. Snippets are independent; stated model/tokenizer/file fixtures are assumed. The tutor never downloads models or executes learner code. Save through the explicit Figure to avoid exporting the wrong current figure. dpi and figsize determine raster pixel dimensions. Vector formats preserve supported vector elements. Close finished figures in batch jobs. Tests can inspect artists without opening a GUI.
